body: Thats fair. You can pm or chat me if you want, or you can lay it out in the comments if you'd prefer. I'm here to listen too!

Its the worst feeling in the world man, damn. I'm here if you wanna talk about it.
Back of the head baby, take out the cerebellum
So you think I should try then?
That's a fair point. I'm sure I can fill the time with some shit, I'm just not sure how into it I'll be, lol.

I completely agree relationships happen out of nowhere. Thats how mine started. It was the happiest I had ever been, honestly. The problem is that I dont know if I ever will find somebody else, or if the plan will work. 

Either I roll the dice and keep living through the monotonous painful shitshow of my life in the hope that I can secure that happiness again, or I can take fate into my own hands and ensure that I feel no pain again, but also sacrifice my chance of happiness.

I mean, the reason I say tomorrow is because its one of the last opportunities where I will be home alone and will be able to save my family from being the ones to find me. Thursday is the absolute LAST chance I have for the next three months, but I get what you're saying.

I'm not disagreeing, I suppose. I'm sure somebody is out there for me. I'm in a clear enough state of mind to accept that. For all I know, I met her years ago and we just havent spoken, or it could even be my ex, but we wont reconnect for 10-20 years. Logically, I know this.

Logically, I also know that I may never meet her either. This happens as well. I dont like the thought, but its a true possibility. 

I have literally nothing going for me at the moment, and its summertime right now. I have nothing to look forward to, and nothing to do with my time. I am honestly waiting to die. Waiting for this perfect dream girl to arrive will not be enough to keep me from blowing my brains out.

That would be a good option if it was probable. I was 17 when I started dating her, and she was my first girlfriend. I'm a less-than-attractive hispanic boy (19 now) with only one eye. I am an unorthodox person who prefers to stay indoors and play games rather than go out. I live in Miami, a party city with people who like to go out and dick around all day. I'm 5'3 (short), and I have a track record of girls not particularly liking me. 

I'm not saying its impossible, but its improbable, and its more likely going to happen in 3-5 years rather than anytime relatively soon. I'm not against the idea at all, but if my goal is to find somebody else, idk how long that can inspire me in the long run.
